content:
The image shows a severely desiccated, shriveled, and necrotic leaf — completely brown and dried out, with curled/twisted tissue. This is consistent with **Die Back**, where progressive tissue death leads to complete necrosis of leaves/shoots, leaving them brown, shrunken, and dead. There is no powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew), no black sooty layer (rules out Sooty Mould), and no discrete lesions with dark margins (rules out Anthracnose). The uniform, complete browning and shriveling points to dieback necrosis.
